messages:
Sam: Quick weekend poll  sunrise hike (Twin Peaks) 6:30am or lazy beach BBQ (Oceanview) 4pm? Short reasons welcome :sunrise_over_mountains::hamburger:
Tess: Hike for me. love the city views in the morning. willing to be on bag-duty (snacks) :backpack:
Ibrahim: Beach BBQ sounds great. I can bring a small portable grill and skewers. low-effort evening vibes. :meat_on_bone:
Keiko: Honestly torn. hike is cooler but beach would be chill after a long week. can we decide by Friday noon?
Sam: Yeah i'll run a quick vote. Reply with just "hike" or "beach"
Tess: hike
Ibrahim: beach
Keiko: hike
Sam: tally 2 hike, 1 beach. still open til Friday noon. also FYI there's a half-marathon route through Twin Peaks on Sunday, but Saturday morning should be fine.
ops-bot: FYI Transit advisory: MUNI bus 37 will have reduced frequency Sat 5-8am due to maintenance. Consider alternate routes or carpool.
Ibrahim: thanks @ops-bot. if we go beach, i can drive (2 seats free) and bring charcoal. who wants a ride?
Tess: if it's hike i might carpool with @Keiko, otherwise ill take public transit.
Keiko: I can drive to the trailhead, 2 seats. i'll bring instant coffee and thermos if it's hike.
Sam: note for beach people: no open flames on that part of Oceanview, so portable grill might be a no-go. we could do pre-grilled skewers instead.
Ibrahim: ah good call. i'll switch to pre-grilled then. thanks for checking.
Tess: tiny logistics q: for the hike, is 6:30AM strict or flexible? i'm not a morning person :sweat_smile:
Sam: flexible to 6:45 if that helps. plan is to leave Castro MUNI stop at 6:15 if folks want to meet there.
Keiko: 6:45 works. i can meetup at Castro and share location.
Ibrahim: leaving final choice to majority. if it stays tied tomorrow morning i'll flip a coin :coin:
Sam: Final check: who definitely prefers beach (say "B") vs hike (say "H")
Tess: H
Ibrahim: B
Keiko: H
Sam: Looks like hike wins 2-1. Plan: Twin Peaks sunrise hike, meet Castro MUNI stop 6:15am, leave by 6:30, bring layers and a headlamp if it's foggy. i'll post an exact map pin Friday night.
Tess: sweet. i'll bring granola bars. can't promise i'll be chipper but i'll be there :coffee:
Ibrahim: enjoy the views y'all. i'll catch the post-hike coffee run instead :wink:
Keiko: see you Saturday. also shouting out @Sam for organizing :clap:
